questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'very large in size'?
explanation: Enormous is correct - E-N-O-R-M-O-U-S. Enormous means very large or great in size.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'very small in size'?
explanation: Miniature is correct - M-I-N-I-A-T-U-R-E. Miniature means a very small version of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to run away quickly'?
explanation: Flee is correct - F-L-E-E. To flee means to run away quickly from danger. Double E.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to move smoothly through water'?
explanation: Glide is correct - G-L-I-D-E. To glide means to move smoothly and effortlessly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'causing great wonder'?
explanation: Magnificent is correct - M-A-G-N-I-F-I-C-E-N-T. Magnificent means impressively beautiful or grand.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to make louder'?
explanation: Amplify is correct - A-M-P-L-I-F-Y. To amplify means to increase the volume or strength of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'shining brightly'?
explanation: Radiant is correct - R-A-D-I-A-N-T. Radiant means sending out light or glowing brightly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to fall down suddenly'?
explanation: Collapse is correct - C-O-L-L-A-P-S-E. To collapse means to fall down or cave in suddenly. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to throw forward'?
explanation: Launch is correct - L-A-U-N-C-H. To launch means to send something forward or set it in motion.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'full of excitement and activity'?
explanation: Vibrant is correct - V-I-B-R-A-N-T. Vibrant means full of life, energy, or bright color.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to hold back from something'?
explanation: Restrain is correct - R-E-S-T-R-A-I-N. To restrain means to hold back or limit.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to become smaller gradually'?
explanation: Diminish is correct - D-I-M-I-N-I-S-H. To diminish means to make or become lesser in size or importance.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to stir up or excite'?
explanation: Agitate is correct - A-G-I-T-A-T-E. To agitate means to make someone troubled or to stir something up.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'showing no emotion'?
explanation: Stoic is correct - S-T-O-I-C. Stoic means enduring pain or difficulty without showing emotion.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to make known publicly'?
explanation: Proclaim is correct - P-R-O-C-L-A-I-M. To proclaim means to announce something officially or publicly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'not willing to give up'?
explanation: Persistent is correct - P-E-R-S-I-S-T-E-N-T. Persistent means continuing firmly despite difficulty.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'greatly surprised'?
explanation: Astonished is correct - A-S-T-O-N-I-S-H-E-D. Astonished means greatly surprised or amazed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'carefully planned'?
explanation: Deliberate is correct - D-E-L-I-B-E-R-A-T-E. Deliberate means done carefully and intentionally.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'deep and complete'?
explanation: Thorough is correct - T-H-O-R-O-U-G-H. Thorough means done completely with attention to all details.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to give power or ability to'?
explanation: Empower is correct - E-M-P-O-W-E-R. To empower means to give authority or strength to someone.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to gather or collect'?
explanation: Accumulate is correct - A-C-C-U-M-U-L-A-T-E. To accumulate means to gather or build up over time. Double C.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to make something worse'?
explanation: Aggravate is correct - A-G-G-R-A-V-A-T-E. To aggravate means to make something more serious or worse. Double G.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'moving with grace'?
explanation: Elegant is correct - E-L-E-G-A-N-T. Elegant means graceful and stylish in appearance or manner.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to overcome by force'?
explanation: Conquer is correct - C-O-N-Q-U-E-R. To conquer means to overcome or gain control by force.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to avoid deliberately'?
explanation: Evade is correct - E-V-A-D-E. To evade means to escape or avoid something skillfully.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'extremely careful and thorough'?
explanation: Meticulous is correct - M-E-T-I-C-U-L-O-U-S. Meticulous means showing great attention to detail.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to satisfy completely'?
explanation: Satiate is correct - S-A-T-I-A-T-E. To satiate means to satisfy someone fully.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'full of strength and energy'?
explanation: Vigorous is correct - V-I-G-O-R-O-U-S. Vigorous means strong, healthy, and full of energy.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'unwilling to work or be active'?
explanation: Lethargic is correct - L-E-T-H-A-R-G-I-C. Lethargic means affected by lethargy or a lack of energy.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to make something perfect'?
explanation: Refine is correct - R-E-F-I-N-E. To refine means to improve or make something more precise.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to cause great distress'?
explanation: Devastate is correct - D-E-V-A-S-T-A-T-E. To devastate means to destroy or cause severe damage.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to scatter in all directions'?
explanation: Disperse is correct - D-I-S-P-E-R-S-E. To disperse means to spread or scatter over a wide area.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'impossible to stop'?
explanation: Relentless is correct - R-E-L-E-N-T-L-E-S-S. Relentless means never stopping or easing. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to make something clear'?
explanation: Illuminate is correct - I-L-L-U-M-I-N-A-T-E. To illuminate means to light up or make something understandable. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'showing deep respect'?
explanation: Reverent is correct - R-E-V-E-R-E-N-T. Reverent means showing deep respect or devotion.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to look at something carefully'?
explanation: Scrutinize is correct - S-C-R-U-T-I-N-I-Z-E. To scrutinize means to examine something very carefully.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to make something more intense'?
explanation: Intensify is correct - I-N-T-E-N-S-I-F-Y. To intensify means to become or make more intense or severe.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to prove something wrong'?
explanation: Refute is correct - R-E-F-U-T-E. To refute means to prove that something is wrong.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to keep something from happening'?
explanation: Prevent is correct - P-R-E-V-E-N-T. To prevent means to stop something from happening.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'very cold and icy'?
explanation: Frigid is correct - F-R-I-G-I-D. Frigid means extremely cold or icy.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'very hot and dry'?
explanation: Scorching is correct - S-C-O-R-C-H-I-N-G. Scorching means extremely hot or burning.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to arrange neatly'?
explanation: Organize is correct - O-R-G-A-N-I-Z-E. To organize means to arrange things in an orderly way.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to move very fast'?
explanation: Accelerate is correct - A-C-C-E-L-E-R-A-T-E. To accelerate means to increase speed. Double C.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to slow down'?
explanation: Decelerate is correct - D-E-C-E-L-E-R-A-T-E. To decelerate means to slow down or reduce speed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to twist out of shape'?
explanation: Distort is correct - D-I-S-T-O-R-T. To distort means to pull or twist out of its natural shape.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'brave and daring'?
explanation: Courageous is correct - C-O-U-R-A-G-E-O-U-S. Courageous means showing bravery in the face of danger.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to move back and forth'?
explanation: Oscillate is correct - O-S-C-I-L-L-A-T-E. To oscillate means to move repeatedly back and forth. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to bring something to life again'?
explanation: Revive is correct - R-E-V-I-V-E. To revive means to restore to life, health, or activity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to search for carefully'?
explanation: Investigate is correct - I-N-V-E-S-T-I-G-A-T-E. To investigate means to carry out a systematic examination.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to feel deep sorrow'?
explanation: Grieve is correct - G-R-I-E-V-E. To grieve means to feel intense sorrow or sadness.
